Melbourne, Australia121 contributions
0
Absolutely delectable - you must go here!
Aug 2024 • Couples
Thanks to other Trip Advisor reviewers, we went to this fabulous restaurant last night for dinner and were blown away by the quality of food, the presentation and staff. The foie gras and duck (pictured) were delicious as were my husband’s pipi pasta & steak. Our cocktails were excellent with the correct measures of alcohol (unlike others we have had in Vietnam). All this was AUD $87 which is amazing value. We will return again and again to this friendly, family run bistro with really excellent French food. It’s a little difficult to find at the end of a lane which is, for the first 2/3rds a motorbike parking lot. I’ve attached some photos from the street view to make it easier to find.
